about: Intuition exercises (PLAN 10, Levels 1-8). 'level' = the level that opens the exercise. 'skills' = the skills of the skill model (PLAN 9.4) that the result feeds. Texts use term marks (PLAN 7.4): a locked term shows its plain words. '{x}' parts are filled in by riyaz/intuition.py. 'Find the key' is a drill (riyaz/drill.py); the others run in riyaz/intuition.py.

exercises.name: Find the key
text: The app names a key. Press any key with this name, as fast as you can.

exercises.name: Echo
text: The app plays a few keys. Listen. Then play the same keys in the same order.
The keys come from where your hand sits in your song.
exercises.prompt: Listen. Then play the same {n} keys.

exercises.name: [[interval|Interval ear|The jump between 2 keys]]
text: The app plays 2 keys, one after the other. How big is the [[interval|interval|jump]]?
Click your answer, or play the same 2 keys.
exercises.prompt: Listen. How big is the [[interval|interval|jump]] from the first key to the second key?

choices.label: Fifth: C up to G (5 white keys)
Same letter: C up to the next C

exercises.name: [[chord|Chord shapes|Shapes of 3 keys]]
text: The app names a [[chord|chord|group of 3 keys]]. Play its 3 keys together.
Start on the key with the name. Then skip one white key, play one, skip one, play one.
exercises.prompt_major: Play {root} [[major_minor|major|with a happy sound]]: 3 keys together.
exercises.prompt_minor: Play {root} [[major_minor|minor|with a sad sound]]: 3 keys together.

exercises.name: [[major_minor|Major or minor|Happy or sad]]
text: The app plays 3 keys together. Do they sound happy or sad?
Click your answer, or play the same 3 keys.
exercises.prompt: Listen. Is the sound happy or sad?

exercises.name: [[chord|Next chord|What comes next]]
text: The app plays 3 [[chord|chords|groups of keys]] of a [[progression|progression|pattern]] and then stops.
Play the 3 keys together that you think come next.
exercises.prompt: Listen to the 3 [[chord|chords|groups of keys]]. Then play the next one.

exercises.name: Find the tune
text: The app plays the start of a song that you know. Find the same keys by ear.
The first key glows. Try keys near it. A wrong key is not a problem: listen and try again.
exercises.prompt: Listen to the start of "{title}". Then play it. The first key glows.

exercises.name: [[chord|Add chords|Add keys together]] to a tune
text: Play a short tune. The next key glows to help you. You can also play your own tune.
The app finds the key family of the tune. Then it gives you [[chord|a chord|3 keys together]] for each group of clicks. Play them.
exercises.prompt: Play the tune of "{title}". The next key glows. Click "My tune is done" when you stop.
exercises.prompt_chord: Your tune uses the keys of {key}. Play [[chord|chord|group]] {i} of {n}: the keys that glow ({name}).

exercises.name: Jam
text: The app plays a [[progression|progression|pattern]] of [[chord|chords|groups of keys]] and the click. Play any keys that glow, when you like.
The keys that glow are the [[scale|scale|key family]] of the song. Your score is the share of your keys from the family.
exercises.prompt: Play along with the app. Use the keys that glow. The jam stops after {count} groups of clicks.

results.right: You got {right} of {rounds} right the first time.
results.melody: You found {right} of {total} keys the first time.
results.jam: You played {presses} keys. {inside} of them were in the key family.
results.jam_few: You played only {presses} keys. Play more keys in the next jam.
